per_question_synthesis.question: What is the mathematical formulation of Bahdanau additive attention?
per_question_synthesis.synthesis: Bahdanau additive attention computes a score with a learned vector and nonlinear transformation: \(a(s,h)=v_a^T\tanh(W_a s+U_a h)\) [1].

per_question_synthesis.question: What are recent efficient variants of attention mechanisms?
per_question_synthesis.synthesis: Sparse attention restricts token-pair computations [2]. Linear approximations via kernel methods reformulate attention to avoid quadratic computation [2]. Exact comparative benchmark results are not provided.

per_question_synthesis.question: How do attention mechanisms perform on WMT and GLUE?
per_question_synthesis.synthesis: The Transformer scores 28.4 BLEU on WMT English-to-German [3]. GLUE scores are not provided.
